comment: She has a very respectable background in political science, but has no concept of teaching and does not make it easy to follow the direction of the class. Pop quizzes are hard and completely random. She grades essays harshly. Grading of in-class presentations seem to have no consistency.
Very easy class, just make sure that the professor likes you and you'll probably get an A. Pop quizzes are a total gamble and most people fail them, but they're a small part of the grade.

Hobgood is a nice woman. There are about 5 speeches and pop quizzes. Everybody fails the quizzes since they are random questions that we never talked about. Class is boring and lectures are off topic. Don't read the readings because they aren't discussed in class. Good feedback and class helped me become an informed speaker, not an easy A.

I had Professor Hobgood for Public Speaking this semester, and I thought she was great! It's definitely important to get on her good side in order to sustain a good grade. Her lectures go off topic often, but you're allowed to be on your computer "taking notes" during the lectures. She gives good feedback on your speeches as well.

I will preface this with: There is no one more qualified to teach this course than Hobgood. But she doesn't know how to teach.  We are assigned anywhere from 10-90 page readings almost every class and then we would never even talk about them. If you can, take any other FYS, use this as a last resort!

Hobgood is a very entertaining person as a whole but not my favorite professor - she assigns lots of readings but rarely uses the material in class so don't bother reading them her quizzes have nothing to do with the reading and are oddly specific questions from her lectures that have almost no structure if you understand her flow you can get an A

Actually the worst teacher I have ever had. She never discusses the readings and just speaks off her mind in class. She is never clear what the prompt is for an essay and grades based on her own political views.

Terrible FYS The White House Said Today!! Never discussed the readings assigned for each class. Class discussions had NO STRUCTURE. You had to show up for class, but felt like a complete waste of time. To top all that, she assigned VERY SPECIFIC papers without ever discussing how to research and write at a college level, the whole point of a FYS.

Mrs. Hobgood is a super nice and sweet woman! If you're terrified of public speaking, however, I would not recommend her for an FYS. Her lectures can get a little off topic or boring, especially if rhetoric is not your thing. If you don't mind writing and public speaking, and show her a little interest in your topic, it is easy to get a good grade.

Mrs. Hobgood is lovely, but her teaching style is flawed. She assigned lengthy readings that were never discussed in class. She went on tangents about random things. Essay and speech guidelines were not clear and she just told students stories instead of answering their questions, so grades were a hit or miss. I do not recommend taking this FYS.

Nice lady, however, her lectures taught me nothing. There are a few where she goes over basic terms of rhetoric, but most of them are about stories unrelated to the readings. You don't need to do the long, boring readings. If they are important readings, she will say so. Papers are confusing and convoluted, so talk to her about them outside class

Very sweet lady, but... long, boring readings due every class, always repetitive and only mildly relevant. Usually 40-80 pages for one class. She spends the whole class lecturing on stuff irrelevant to readings & course content, and then assigns super specific/difficult papers. Grades harshly and papers not based on class discussions

Really difficult FYS if writing research papers and giving memorized speeches isn't your strong suit. That being said you don't really need to do the hundreds of pages of assigned reading and Hobgood is a VERY interesting lady. She worked in the White House and brings in really cool guest speakers. She has a cut throat grandma type vibe.

Mrs. Hobgood is a very sweet woman who truly cares about her students. I'm not really sure what I learned in her class though. There were plenty of long, boring readings that we barely addressed in class. Class feels super long as it's mostly just her talking, but she tends to get on interesting tangents.

I love Mrs. Hobgood with my whole entire heart. She is inspirational. She explains the points she wants to make through heartwarming and thought provoking stories. She brings dry readings to life. If you can/want to learn to speak and to write, take this class. Not only is she adorable, but she is kind and 100% rooting for you from day 1.

very sweet lady. Grandmotherly in the sense that she does care about her students but also in the sense that she could and will talk to a brick wall for upwards of 45 minutes. Very boring lecturer, but fairly easy grader. Easy class if you are an athlete, not much out of class work besides speech writing/practicing

I took Professor Hobgood's class in preparation for my job next semester as a speech consultant and it was a great experience. I'm not majoring in anything related to rhetoric, but if you're a good speaker and writer, this is definitely an option worth exploring. Don't be deterred by the fact that you have to take a class, it's very manageable.

Dr. H is one of the best professors you'll come across, pay attention in her class. Readings are excessive but are really fun at times. Her discussions can go off topic but she is always in favor of her students. Papers are long but she grades them judiciously. Motivates you to achieve the highest always. Make sure you drop in her office hours!

I'm not sure what I really learned from this class. Never went over the assigned readings. You have to be up on your current events to participate in class discussions. Don't take if you don't like giving formal speeches. There are three 10 page papers assigned throughout the course which is way more than any other FYS assigns. Easyfair grader.

Mrs. Hobgood is down to earth, enthusiastic about rhetoric, and eager to help you in your academic ventures. She's not too difficult when it comes to grading as long as you show that you've put in effort. Sometimes she's not very clear on assignment expectations, but other than that I'd highly recommend her and her FYS.

Mrs. Hobgood is an extremely wonderful woman, but her class is not what I had anticipated. I didn't expect the class to focus on rhetoric because it was a fys, but it's all we talk about. She goes off on countless tangents and we never talk about the excruciatingly boring readings. If you can't write or give speeches, then don't take the class!

Professor Hobgood can be a little unclear sometimes but her lectures are interesting and she is very enthusiastic. She's extremely helpful outside of class and the course itself drastically improved my writing and speaking skills.
challenging but i learned SO much from her class!

She's a very challeging prof with the amount of readings and essays but you do learn a lot from this class! It made me a bette writer, speaker, and even convinced me to join the speech center. Take this class!!

Mrs. Hobgood is by far one of the best professors I've had the pleasure to study under. I took all of the classes I could take with her. She is a wonderful mentor. She's hard because she truly cares about her students. She is extremely smart, and with her experience & stories from the White House, any student is lucky to learn from her.

Dr. Hobgood is the most brilliant professor I've had at UR. She worked in the White House and is a leading national scholar on rhetoric. She is also extremely accessible and heads up the Speech Center, one of UR's best assets. Become her favorite by speaking out and sounding smart, and she'll reward you.

OK, I thought I loved her until I got my grade. She picks favorites and tells too many personal stories. Really a nice person at heart, but she is challenging, unclear, and oftentimes unfair. I felt like I worked a lot harder then what my grade reflected. You better memorize every little thing she says. Motherly figure to a lot of her students.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Mrs. Hobgood! The class was extremely interesting, and she was always willing to help. She definitely holds her students to high standards, but as long as you show her that you are serious, she'll love you.

Mrs. Hobgood is a wonderful professor. She loves teaching and challenging her students, and guiding them not only intellectually but life as well. She admits to being hard and that taking more than 2 of her classes in a semester is painful. Having this honesty though proves what a caring person she is. She's so intelligent and her laugh infectious.

Mrs. Hobgood is the worst professor at Richmond. She is a witch. Her emails and comments are condescening and unhelpful. She picks favorites and her "lectures" bore the class to tears. She talks only about herself, and the only time I learned anything about speech writing the entire semester was when we had guest speakers. Horrible experience.

Terrific teacher! Very passionate about what she teaches, always has an answer for everything, very approachable and extremely friendly. If you want to truly learn how to become a better public speaker, I highly recommend this class & Mrs. Hobgood. If you put in effort, she notices and takes that into account. Outstanding teacher!!!

The worst professor I've had at UR. She is unclear in what she asks for and then will not be helpful during lectures. She will assign lots of reading but discuss the minimum of it.  It's a shame her lecturing is so poor becuase she is really smart. You just have to ask a million questions to get one answer. I will not take another class with her.

was dreading taking a public address course, but bc mrs. hobgood is so passionate about what she teaches i've loved the course! she's so knowledgable, yet definitely has a motherly personality. she expects a lot from you, but if you keep up with the work, visit the speech center frequently, and show your interest in the subject matter, you're golde
If you do your work and get on your good side you'll def. get an A.  There is A LOT of work but it is managable.  Do not take two of her classes in one semester unless you like to be punished.
Mrs. Hobgood is so sweet! I guess a lot of people struggle in her class because she expects truly excellent work. She is just so cute and motherly...I love her.
way too conservative

She is very hard, but if you're a good student and want to challenge yourself...take this class! Amazing!  I didn't think she liked me, but I went in for extra help and she really appreciated my willingness to learn.  College is for people who want to LEARN!

she was so fake-happy about everything...once graded me down for being "too creative" and "too original" with a thesis. said george w. was an example of a good orator (not true even if you love the guy)... ps. watch out, if she thinks you're gay, you're screwed!
prejudice against students she doesn't like. you'll do fine if she takes an early liking to you. don't eat in her class.
Very biased and prejudiced against students. Has more horror stories about her speech classes than students in them.
great if you can get along with her/if she likes you
No Comments
